segments.name: Surgical robotics
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells image-guided surgical robotic systems for minimally invasive urologic surgery treating benign prostatic hyperplasia.
segments.evidence: We develop, manufacture and sell the AquaBeam Robotic System and HYDROS Robotic System, which are advanced, image-guided, surgical robotic systems for use in minimally invasive urologic surgery, with an initial focus on treating benign prostatic hyperplasia, or BPH.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals, surgery centers, leasing companies and distributors pay for robotic systems and single-use disposable handpieces, via direct sales or sales-type leasing arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: Currently, in the United States, we primarily sell our products to hospitals, or end customers, and to a lesser extent, distribution partners, ambulatory surgery centers and leasing companies.
